info.title: MICROSERVICE_DEV_SIM Swap Management API
info.description: The SIM Swap Management API facilitates the seamless initiation and management of SIM card swaps for mobile service providers. This endpoint allows authorized users to request swaps, ensuring that customer transitions between different SIM cards are efficient and secure. The primary consumers of this API are telecom operators and customer service applications supporting user account modifications. Typical use cases include subscribers upgrading their SIMs, replacing lost or damaged cards, and managing number transfers across different devices.

post.summary: Initiates a new SIM swap request.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate a SIM swap for their account. It requires the relevant user information and the new SIM details to process the request. Please ensure all data provided is accurate to avoid delays in the swap process.
